# Secure SAP Core

# Market Context & Urgency
Traditional, fragmented SAP security approaches can no longer keep pace with the **speed, complexity, and scale of modern threats**. Security must evolve into a **continuous, integrated, and automated capability embedded within SAP operations**.

- Cybersecurity and risk exposure have become the **primary investment drivers in SAP environments**, overtaking traditional transformation initiatives 
- SAP systems are increasingly targeted due to their role as the **core transactional backbone across finance, supply chain, and operations** 
- Regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, SOX, EU AI Act) are becoming more complex and impose stricter penalties 
- Data exfiltration, integration vulnerabilities, and patch management gaps are among the **most critical risks in modern SAP landscapes** 
- AI adoption is accelerating, introducing new identity types and risk vectors while organizations remain underprepared 
- Security is no longer just a control function—it directly impacts cost, resilience, and competitiveness 
- IT risk has evolved into a **top enterprise risk category**, driven by system centralization, cloud exposure, and AI-enabled attack vectors 

---

# Customer Pain Points

## Fragmented Security & Lack of End-to-End Ownership
- SAP security is often split across Basis, IAM, audit, and external tools, resulting in no unified control model 
- Organizations operate with **limited visibility and slow response capabilities due to siloed structures** 

## Reactive Compliance & Manual Controls
- GRC processes remain **manual, audit-driven, and reactive**, rather than continuous and automated 
- Regulatory complexity creates **high operational overhead without scalable control frameworks** 

## Identity Explosion & Access Risks
- Growth of machine identities, service accounts, and automation leads to **unmanageable access landscapes** 
- Lack of automated SoD and lifecycle management results in **persistent audit findings and fraud exposure** 

## Cloud Misconfigurations & Hybrid Complexity
- Security responsibilities shift to the customer in cloud environments 
- Misconfigurations and inconsistent governance create **systemic vulnerabilities across landscapes** 

## Security Gaps During SAP Transformations
- S/4HANA migrations and system changes frequently introduce **uncontrolled risks due to missing security integration** 

---

# Business Impact of Inaction
Without transformation, SAP environments remain **high-risk, high-cost, and operationally unstable**.

- Regulatory penalties of up to €10 million or 2% of global revenue 
- Increased likelihood of **data breaches and operational disruptions** due to unpatched vulnerabilities and weak controls 
- Escalating **audit findings, penalties, and compliance costs** due to lack of automation and transparency 
- Prolonged recovery times due to insufficient resilience and detection capabilities in cyber incidents 
- Loss of competitive trust as security becomes a **core differentiator in enterprise decision-making** 

---

# Target Vision / Future State
A **resilient, scalable, and continuously governed SAP core** aligned with business growth and regulatory demands.

- Fully integrated **end-to-end SAP security architecture across all systems and environments** 
- **Automated identity lifecycle and SoD enforcement** across human and machine identities 
- Continuous, real-time **risk detection, monitoring, and response embedded into operations** 
- Audit-ready compliance through **automated controls and standardized frameworks** 
- Unified governance across **on-premise, cloud, and hybrid SAP landscapes** 
- Security embedded into every phase of SAP transformation (design → build → operate) 

---

# Solution

## What the Solution Is
- An end-to-end SAP Security, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) service combining consulting, advisory, automation, implementation, and managed operations 
- A structured approach to securing SAP environments across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid landscapes 
- A service designed to continuously reduce risk, ensure compliance, and stabilize SAP-driven business operations 

---

## Core Service Components

### Security & Resilience Services
- Design and implementation of SAP security concepts tailored to customer requirements 
- SAP security assessments, architecture design, and system hardening 

### Identity & Access Management (IAM) Services
- Design and implementation of SAP authorization concepts 
- Implementation of automated user lifecycle management (onboarding, changes, offboarding) 
- Segregation of Duties (SoD) frameworks and continuous monitoring 
- Machine identity and service account governance 

### Compliance & Governance Services
- Implementation of internal control systems (ICS) and audit-ready governance structures 
- Preconfigured compliance frameworks aligned with regulations (e.g., GDPR, NIS2, DORA) 
- Automated controls and continuous compliance monitoring 
- Audit preparation, support, and optimization 

### Cloud & Hybrid Security Services
- SAP cloud security configuration and governance aligned with the Shared Responsibility Model 
- Identity and access governance across cloud and hybrid landscapes 
- Secure configuration and continuous validation of cloud environments 

### GRC & Compliance Services
- Implementation and operation of SAP GRC solutions (Access Control, Process Control) 
- Definition and maintenance of SoD frameworks and risk rule sets 
- Design and automation of internal control systems (ICS) 
- Audit support, evidence provisioning, and compliance reporting 
- Preconfigured compliance frameworks aligned with regulations (e.g., GDPR, NIS2, DORA, SOX) 

---

## Automation & Optimization Services
- Automation of recurring security, IAM, and compliance processes 
- Standardized templates, control libraries, and governance models 
- SAP license and authorization optimization 
- Fiori UX and authorization improvements 

---

## Advisory & Enablement Services
- Security roadmaps and transformation support (e.g., S/4HANA transitions) 
- AI risk management and integration into SAP security 
- Training and enablement for internal teams
